title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-10

ai_review.summary: A superbly restored sound‑board capture of the June 10 1973 show, delivering crystal‑clear audio and showcasing monumental jams like Eyes of the World, Dark Star and a soaring Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller restoration turns this legendary 1973 performance into an almost pristine listening experience – “beefy” yet clarified sound with only minor clipping. Reviewers rave about the band’s deep groove, especially Jerry Garcia’s transcendent solos and the towering Eyes of the World jam, while Phil’s bass, Keith’s harmonies and Bill’s jazzy drumming also get strong mentions.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly praise both the musical performance and the sound‑board restoration; only one reviewer notes a sterile board sound, resulting in an overall rating well above average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Beefy, high‑fidelity mix with minor clipping that has been electronically clarified; listeners describe it as crisp, rich and the best‑sounding SBD of this era, though a few note it lacks ambient room feel.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight first set that builds into a jam‑heavy second set with seamless segues, culminating in an epic third set; the overall pacing is praised for its groove and improvisational peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for shredding solos, “time‑space continuum” guitar work and an ecstatic tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for solid bass presence, good separation in the mix, and his characteristic “Phil Zone” feel.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s vocal harmonies are highlighted as a key element of the band’s sound on this night.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Kreutzmann) praised for jazzy drumming, keeping tight time and driving the jams forward.
